title: Carbonyl-based organic electrode materials spanning from nonaqueous rechargeable lithium to calcium batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,7756-7791
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06017B, Review Article
Kun Zhao, Xingxing Wang, Wenfang Feng, Alexandre Ponrouch, Philippe Poizot, Michel Armand, Zhibin Zhou, Heng Zhang
The present review delves into the carbonyl-based organic electrode materials and focuses on the similarities and distinctions between calcium and lithium chemistries, aiming to offer viable solutions towards more sustainable battery technology.
